industry: Enriched Isotopes / Helium and LNG / Nuclear Fuels
thesis: ASP Isotopes runs five businesses: the Renergen/Tetra4 helium and LNG project in South Africa, the PET Labs radiopharmacy chain, Silicon-28 and carbon isotope enrichment for semiconductors and quantum computing, the Quantum Leap Energy nuclear-fuels subsidiary, and Alpa Theranostics. The shares have fallen ~75% in twelve months to $2.60 as commercialisation deadlines slipped repeatedly, leaving a ~$399M market cap against ~$255M of Q2 2026 cash and TTM revenue of $30.85M. Phase 1 liquid helium commissioning began in August 2026 into a market where roughly half of global supply is offline, with contracted helium above $600/Mcf. Downgraded to HOLD / SPEC.: the sum-of-the-parts discount is real but management has missed nearly every self-imposed date, Phase 2's ~$750M DFC and Standard Bank debt is undocumented, and a fiduciary-duty investigation was announced on 28 September 2026.

drivers: Phase 1 liquid helium reaches nameplate 250 kg/day and 2,500 GJ/day LNG, delivering the ~$27M annualised revenue management has published
50-75% of Phase 1 helium capacity locked into 5-15 year take-or-pay contracts at ~$600/Mcf against spot prints above $2,000/Mcf
First commercial Silicon-28 shipment at 99% enrichment against three already-signed U.S. customer contracts
Noble Africa reverse merger with ENDRA closes and NOBA lists, crystallising the helium asset value with ASPI at ~89%
QLE listing plus South African civilian enrichment authorisation and the Necsa services contract put a separate value on HALEU optionality
DFC and Standard Bank sign ~$750M of Phase 2 senior debt, de-risking the $360M revenue expansion

base_case.assumptions: Helium production starts late in 2026 and ramps through 2027 rather than hitting nameplate immediately. Renergen approaches the ~$27M annualised revenue figure during 2027 while PET Labs delivers ~$14M FY2026 and keeps compounding above 30%. Noble Africa lists, QLE listing slips, and stable-isotope revenue stays immaterial. No equity raise below $3 and the existing ~$255M cash pile funds operations into 2028.

risks: Helium ramp slips again beyond 2026, extending the pattern of missed self-imposed deadlines
Silicon-28 remains pre-commercial into 2027 as the remaining OEM compressor upgrades drag on
Equity raise at or below the current price on top of 153.31M shares already outstanding and 23.16M registered in July 2026
Phase 2 DFC and Standard Bank debt never reaches binding definitive agreement, stranding the $360M revenue plan
Halper Sadeh fiduciary-duty investigation escalates into litigation or a governance event
Helium prices normalise as Qatari capacity returns, undercutting the ~$600/Mcf contract assumption

catalysts.event: Confirmation of first liquid helium production at Tetra4 Phase 1 — management committed to production prior to 30 September 2026 and had not confirmed it as of 29 September
First commercial Silicon-28 shipment at 99% enrichment to one of three signed U.S. customers
Noble Africa reverse merger with ENDRA Life Sciences closes and lists on Nasdaq as NOBA with ~$50M private placement
Q3 2026 earnings — first quarter that could include helium revenue
Updated Tetra4 geological resource estimate, first comprehensive review since the 2021 Sproule assessment
Phase 2 construction start and binding definitive agreements for ~$750M of DFC and Standard Bank senior debt
Quantum Leap Energy standalone listing and potential tax-efficient distribution of QLE stock to ASPI holders
Alpa Theranostics first nanobody radiotherapeutic candidate enters human clinical trials, initial results 1H 2027

key_risks: Chronic schedule slippage — Silicon-28 shipped samples in August 2025 and is still pre-commercial; the QLE spin-off targeted for H1 2026 has not happened
Cash burn of roughly $35M per quarter against ~$255M of cash, with TTM EBITDA near -$69.1M
Dilution risk on 153.31M shares outstanding, a ~$210M raise earlier in 2026 priced far above today, and 23.16M shares registered in July 2026
Phase 2 is unfunded — the ~$750M DFC and Standard Bank package has no binding definitive agreement and the build is ~44 months
Single-asset concentration in one Free State, South Africa gas field, with local power, permitting and currency exposure
Halper Sadeh LLC fiduciary-duty investigation of officers and directors announced 28 September 2026
Helium price normalisation if Qatari and Russian supply returns faster than expected
Nuclear licensing risk — ASPI has not applied its enrichment technology to U-235 beyond the Necsa services contract
$79.1M of third-party QLE convertible notes convert into QLE equity on a listing, diluting ASPI's subsidiary stake
Sell-side targets averaging $13.00 have not been revised down alongside a 75% decline, so consensus offers no valuation anchor
